offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures, rents and sells work uniforms, protective clothing, floor mats, towels and restroom supplies to businesses. Garments are laundered, repaired and delivered to customers on a weekly route-based service from its own plants and branches.

primary_products.value: work uniforms; protective and flame-resistant clothing; floor mats; towels and linens; restroom supplies

primary_services.value: uniform rental and laundering; floor mat and linen service; restroom and facility supplies service; first aid and safety supplies; cleanroom garment services

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, auto services, food processors, healthcare, hospitality, retailers, and cleanroom customers

end_markets.value: manufacturing; automotive services; food processing; healthcare; hospitality and retail

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: recurring weekly rental of uniforms, mats and linens under multi-year contracts; product sales: direct sale of garments and cleanroom products; service fees: laundering, repair, and replacement of rental items
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: launders, delivers and services rented garments and mats for business customers; OEM / manufacturer: makes garments in own and contracted plants for rental programs and sale; asset operator: owns rental garment inventory, laundry plants and delivery fleets serving businesses
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, plus Europe, manufacturing in Mexico and Central America

specialization.value: related lines: uniform rental, mats and linens, restroom supplies, first aid, and cleanroom garments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: employed route sales and service representatives selling to business customers; own locations: company-operated laundry plants and customer service centers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental wastewater rules, OSHA workplace safety standards, and garment flame-resistance standards

notes: Operations also include some Europe; geography set to North America as the core is US and Canada.
